mapper.select: SELECT a.seq AS answer_seq, a.participant_seq, sl_start.occur_date AS startDate, sl_end.occur_date AS endDate, CASE WHEN sl_end.occur_date IS NOT NULL THEN FLOOR((sl_end.occur_date - sl_start.occur_date) * 24 * 60 * 60) ELSE NULL END AS response_time, CASE WHEN sl_end.occur_date IS NULL THEN '중간 이탈' ELSE '완료' END AS status FROM answer a LEFT JOIN survey_log sl_start ON sl_start.answer_seq = a.seq AND sl_start.cc_seq = 23 LEFT JOIN survey_log sl_end ON sl_end.answer_seq = a.seq AND sl_end.cc_seq = 31 WHERE sl_start.occur_date >= #{startDate} AND (sl_end.occur_date <= #{endDate} ) AND (sl_start.survey_seq = #{surveySeq}) ORDER BY a.participant_seq

WITH combined_data AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN sl_end.occur_date IS NOT NULL AND (sl_end.occur_date - sl_start.occur_date) * 24 * 60 * 60 <= 60 THEN '빠른 응답자' WHEN sl_end.occur_date IS NULL THEN '설문 이탈자' ELSE '설문 완료자' END AS status, sl_start.occur_date AS start_date, sl_end.occur_date AS end_date FROM answer a LEFT JOIN survey_log sl_start ON a.seq = sl_start.answer_seq AND sl_start.cc_seq = 23 LEFT JOIN survey_log sl_end ON a.seq = sl_end.answer_seq AND sl_end.cc_seq = 31 WHERE sl_start.occur_date IS NOT NULL AND sl_start.survey_seq = #{surveySeq} ) SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percentage FROM combined_data WHERE (TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{startDate} AND TO_CHAR(end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= #{endDate}) OR (TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= #{startDate} AND end_date IS NULL) GROUP BY status
